cases.description: Chinese enterprise multi-page generation with full business IA coverage
cases.prompt: 为“凌创智能”生成企业官网，要求一次性输出完整多页站点，必须包含：首页、核心产品、产品中心、解决方案、案例、关于我们、定价、支持中心、博客、联系我们、隐私政策、服务条款。整体风格要电影级视觉质感、工业科技气质、主题统一，含清晰导航和可转化CTA。

cases.description: Single-page prompt should not be force-expanded into enterprise routes
cases.prompt: Create a single-page cinematic homepage for a design-led startup. Keep it strictly one page with navigation, hero, feature highlights, proof, CTA, and footer only.
